status: four-panel >=1-day persistence test frozen after x-y-time-only preflight and before vertical output
role: post-freeze exploratory temporal-stability mechanism test; cannot alter frozen v0.3.8

ecological_hypotheses.stable_individual_organization: Centered vertical organization remains individually predictive when self-training sessions are separated from the target by at least one day.
ecological_hypotheses.transient_context: Individual identity is mainly a short-lived state and collapses when nearby-in-time self sessions are excluded.

state_definition.session_time: median timestamp of valid speed×turn endpoints

estimator.vertical_centering: subtract each retained session's median primary height before selecting valid kinematic endpoints
estimator.conditional_profile: P(centered residual height | 5-km cell, speed×turn state)
estimator.self_training: same individual's sessions in same cohort with absolute session-median-time lag >=1 day
estimator.common_weighting: equal-session self distribution over jointly supported cell×state strata, applied identically to self and other vertical profiles
estimator.target_scoring: target kinematic endpoints on strata supported by both predictors

calibration.preserve: session time, x-y-time state and centered vertical outcomes attached to each session block; exact per-cohort label session-count multiset preserved
calibration.lag_rebuild: after each label permutation, recompute lag-qualified self sessions from permuted identity labels and fixed session times
calibration.panel_pass_rule: exact observed preflight n; calibrated common-cell identity >0; one-sided p(null>=observed)<=0.05

decision_matrix.3_or_4_pass: Vertical organization persists across >=1-day separation in most structurally evaluable panels, supporting a temporally stable individual component beyond short-lived nightly context.
decision_matrix.1_or_2_pass: Temporal persistence is context-dependent; short-lived context explains part of the comparative pattern.
decision_matrix.0_pass: Removing self sessions within one day removes most identity signal in this subset, making transient context a leading explanation.

synthesis.generalization_limit: No inference to Eidolon or to persistence beyond the tracking lags represented by each source.

claim_boundary: >=1-day persistence does not prove genetic determination, personality or fixed intrinsic traits.
The test only distinguishes stability beyond short-term context at this lag scale.
Longer-lag persistence remains structurally unresolved in some panels.
This extension remains outside frozen v0.3.8.
stop_rule: Do not change the 1-day lag, session-time definition, subset, 5-km grid, speed2_turn2 state, centering, bins, 50-event support, expected n, B/seeds or pass criteria after output.
If exact observed n differs from preflight expected n, invalidate rather than retune.
Do not introduce a shorter lag as rescue.
